name: marquee
description: Marquee — a personal movie watchlist. React + Express + Postgres.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm -w client run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
